import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.duplicated().sum(), w.year.isna().sum(), w.row_id.duplicated().sum())
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']).drop_duplicates('work_id')
w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','count']).unstack())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).dropna().mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp={k:v for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in grp.values()])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high']:
  print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('ed1',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
pp=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))]
print(len(pp)); print(pp.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).head(8)[['passage_id','technology_named','confidence']])
E
